svg.title: Four work packages for understanding the mind
svg.desc: A copy of the user-edited v4. The original WP1 permutation violins and WP3 daily trajectories are retained. WP1 and WP3, and the two WP2 rows together, share the unchanged WP4 plotting height. Pilot labels use six-point Arial.
